title: The Museum of Three.js
summary: An interactive 3D virtual exhibition pavilion featuring 22 interactive exhibits spanning procedural models, custom GLSL shaders, particle simulations, and retro-tech artifacts. Built with Three.js r160 and Vite v5.
outcomes: Production build executes in 384ms across 24 code-split chunks with zero errors
Sustained 60 FPS performance via dynamic spotlight pooling and distance culling
Passed multi-agent quality gate reviews with composite average 9.2/10 and 100% brand compliance

title: Nepo Baby Magazine — Desi Kitsch Web Toy
summary: An immersive, maximalist Indian Folk-Pop and Desi Kitsch interactive web toy experience. Features an interactive 3D book mockup with artwork file upload, an iTunes-style cover flow, and draggable polaroids.

title: Nepo Baby Magazine with Blender
summary: A maximalist digital editorial web experience integrating layered responsive layouts with 3D canvas rendering and embedded 3D assets including a coupe model turntable and animated marquees.

title: Classic Tata Truck Cabin Simulator & The Bazaar
summary: An interactive first-person driver-cabin simulator of a classic Indian Tata 1613 SE truck featuring interactive horn audio, throttle revving, cassette stereo, live gauges, and switchable driving scenes alongside The Bazaar panoramic canvas.
